page.content:
Mistletoe killing that sets the path to Ragnarok.

How Death of Baldur connects

  • Character: Baldur — Baldur dies and goes to Helheim.
  • Character: Loki — Loki guided the mistletoe that killed Baldur.
  • Character: Frigg — Frigg's missed oath on mistletoe makes Baldur's death possible.
  • Event: Ragnarok — Baldur's death darkens the age that ends at Ragnarok.

What is Death of Baldur?

The death of Baldur — Hod's blind shot, Loki's guidance, Hel's refusal — is the crime the Aesir cannot undo and the grief that darkens the last age.

Key threads lead to Baldur, Loki, Frigg and Ragnarok.
